zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 托盘更清爽，官网焕新
changes: 菜单栏托盘改为紧凑分组布局，输出清晰度可直接点选，贴图板预览与截图设置更易查找
“更多”默认收起帮助与声明；“检查更新”和“关于”始终直接可见
应用图标和官网更新为蓝色视觉；中英文首页加入空间画布与可操作的贴图演示
官网演示在 WebGL 不可用时仍显示静态作品，并支持减少动态效果设置
应用与 DMG 已通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: A cleaner menu and a refreshed website
changes: The menu bar panel now uses compact groups, direct output-quality choices, and clearer pinboard previews and capture settings.
More keeps help and notices collapsed by default, while Check for Updates and About remain directly visible.
The app icon and website adopt a blue visual style; the Chinese and English homepages add a spatial canvas and interactive pin demo.
The website demo keeps static artwork visible without WebGL and respects reduced-motion settings.
The app and DMG are Apple-notarized, and the Sparkle update package is signed.
